answer: In blockchain consensus, an AI economic model uses its costly tethered resources to deploy unique cipher proofs across disparate networks, rendering shallow fable-like Sybil identities ineffective. A node mimicking a thousand identities cannot maintain meaningful economic weight in a tundra of resource-linked participation, as each imitation demands significant cryptographic overhead, neutralizing diluted influence. The attacker bears stifling costs adapting to varied, secured environments, thwarting anonymity.
